1.
List revised.
2. No one appears on behalf of the applicants to press this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
Sri M.C. Singh, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 is not present even when the matter is taken in the revised list.
3. Sri Shashikant Pandey, learned counsel for the State is present.

4. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants- Kailash, Ajay,
Dayaram and Smt. Poonam, with the following prayers:
"It is therefore, Most Respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to allow this application and quash the entire proceedings of Case No. 3096 of 2016 State Vs. Kialash and others pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate Bagpat including the charge sheet No.6 of 2016 dated 18.3.2016, Under Section 498-A, 323, 506, 354-B, 294, 376/511 I.P.C. and Under Section 3/4 DP Act, filed against applicant No.1 and 2 and Charge Sheet No.6 of 2016 dated 10.2.2016, Under Section 498-A, 323, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 DP ACT, filed against appellant No.3 and 4 Police Station in Case Crime No.103 of 2015 Police Station Mahila Thana, District Bagpat.

It is further prayed that the Hon'ble Court may be pleased to stay the further proceedings of Case No. 3096 of 2016 State Vs. Kialash and others pending in the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate Bagpat Under Section 498-A, 323, 506, 354-B, 294,
376/511 I.P.C. and Under Section 3/4 Crime No.103 of 2015 Police DP Act, Station Mahila Thana, District Bagpat."
